cards.example_en: Buying better tools was a good investment for our bakery.
cards.example_zh: 购买更好的工具对我们面包店来说是一笔不错的投资。
cards.explain_zh: 通常搭配in；表示投资行为时常作不可数名词。

cards.example_en: My score improved after a week of practice.
cards.example_zh: 练习一周后，我的分数提高了。
cards.explain_zh: score可作名词或动词；score a goal指进球得分。

cards.example_en: Test scores provide useful information, but they cannot fully reflect students' creativity or practical skills.
cards.example_zh: 考试分数能提供有用的信息，却无法全面反映学生的创造力或实践技能。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Schools should organize practical workshops that help students develop communication skills and prepare for employment.
cards.example_zh: 学校应组织实践工作坊，帮助学生培养沟通技能并为就业做好准备。
cards.explain_zh: 英式也常拼作organise；organize是规范拼写。

cards.example_en: Our weekend trip to the coast was wonderfully relaxing.
cards.example_zh: 我们周末的海滨之旅让人十分放松。
cards.explain_zh: trip 是可数名词；travel 表示旅行活动时通常不可数。

cards.example_en: A narrow path leads to the beach beyond the dunes.
cards.example_zh: 一条狭窄的小路通向沙丘另一边的海滩。
cards.explain_zh: beyond不仅表位置，也可表示超出能力或限度。

cards.example_en: Our cat likes to sleep beside the warm radiator.
cards.example_zh: 我们的猫喜欢睡在温暖的暖气片旁边。
cards.explain_zh: 过去式和过去分词均为slept；入睡用fall asleep。

cards.example_en: We watched small fish swimming under the wooden bridge.
cards.example_zh: 我们看着小鱼在木桥下游动。
cards.explain_zh: 表示多条鱼通常仍用fish；鱼肉为不可数名词。

cards.example_en: I promise to return your bicycle before dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我保证晚饭前把自行车还给你。
cards.explain_zh: 用promise to do，不用promise doing。

cards.example_en: She has the potential to be a great singer.
cards.example_zh: 她有潜力成为一名出色的歌手。

cards.example_en: After a short nap, I had energy to cook.
cards.example_zh: 小睡一会儿后，我有精力做饭了。
cards.explain_zh: 表示精力或能源时通常不可数，不说 an energy。

cards.example_en: We had trouble opening the stiff kitchen window.
cards.example_zh: 厨房的窗户很紧，我们费了好大劲才打开。
cards.explain_zh: 表示做某事有困难，用have trouble doing。

cards.example_en: The price seems to bear no relation to quality.
cards.example_zh: 这个价格似乎与质量毫无关系。
cards.explain_zh: 国家或群体间的关系常用复数relations。

cards.example_en: The price seems to bear no relation to quality.
cards.example_zh: 这个价格似乎与质量毫无关系。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please don't touch the pan; it is still hot.
cards.example_zh: 请别碰锅，它还很烫。
cards.explain_zh: 保持联系用keep in touch with someone。

cards.example_en: I saved the file before switching off my laptop.
cards.example_zh: 我关掉笔记本电脑之前保存了文件。
cards.explain_zh: file a complaint 指正式投诉，不是把投诉归档。

cards.example_en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
cards.example_zh: 有人把一个行李箱放在了走廊正中央。
cards.explain_zh: 名词常用the middle of；形容词直接修饰名词。

cards.example_en: Someone left a suitcase in the middle of the hallway.
cards.example_zh: 有人把一个行李箱放在了走廊正中央。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We ordered fresh orange juice at the hotel bar.
cards.example_zh: 我们在酒店的酒吧点了鲜榨橙汁。
cards.explain_zh: 表禁止用bar sb from doing；过去式barred。

cards.example_en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我不吃午饭时就会头痛。
cards.explain_zh: 疾病常用suffer from；损失、损坏常直接接在suffer后。

cards.example_en: I suffer from headaches when I skip lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我不吃午饭时就会头痛。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our strategy was to save a little every week.
cards.example_zh: 我们的策略是每周存一点钱。
cards.explain_zh: 常用a strategy for doing sth表示做某事的策略。

cards.example_en: The pond is deep at the far end, so swimming is banned there.
cards.example_zh: 池塘远端水深，所以那里禁止游泳。

cards.example_en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
cards.example_zh: 除了我弟弟，大家都想走路回家。
cards.explain_zh: except排除在外；besides表示另外还包括。

cards.example_en: Everyone except my brother wanted to walk home.
cards.example_zh: 除了我弟弟，大家都想走路回家。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: There are clean towels on the shelf beside you.
cards.example_zh: 你旁边的架子上有干净的毛巾。
cards.explain_zh: clean是干净；clear是清澈或清楚，不能随意互换。

cards.example_en: Investing in clean energy can reduce air pollution while creating new employment opportunities in developing industries.
cards.example_zh: 投资清洁能源可以减少空气污染，同时在新兴产业中创造就业机会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I tend to feel sleepy after a big lunch.
cards.example_zh: 我午饭吃得多之后往往会犯困。
cards.explain_zh: tend to do表示往往会；tend to someone表示照料。

cards.example_en: This new treatment is a major advance in medicine.
cards.example_zh: 这种新疗法是医学上的一大进步。
cards.explain_zh: in advance表示提前；advanced表示先进的或高级的。

cards.example_en: This new treatment is a major advance in medicine.
cards.example_zh: 这种新疗法是医学上的一大进步。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Please fill the jug with water for our guests.
cards.example_zh: 请把水壶装满水，给客人们喝。
cards.explain_zh: fill A with B表示用B装满A；be filled with表示充满。

cards.example_en: A famous film star waved to us outside the cinema.
cards.example_zh: 一位著名的电影明星在电影院外向我们招手。
cards.explain_zh: star in表示“主演”；过去式starred，进行式starring。
cards.source: Word Atlas; existing QuizMario bilingual correction

cards.example_en: Our home network connects three laptops and a printer.
cards.example_zh: 我们的家庭网络连接着三台笔记本电脑和一台打印机。
cards.explain_zh: network强调多个节点之间相互连接。

cards.example_en: An efficient public transport network can reduce traffic congestion and improve access to employment.
cards.example_zh: 高效的公共交通网络可以缓解交通拥堵，并让人们更方便地前往工作地点。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I generally walk to work unless it rains.
cards.example_zh: 除非下雨，否则我通常步行上班。
cards.explain_zh: generally表示多数情况，并非毫无例外；句首可用generally speaking。

cards.example_en: My aunt is recovering well after her knee operation.
cards.example_zh: 我姑姑膝盖手术后恢复得很好。
cards.explain_zh: 手术部位用on连接：an operation on the knee。

cards.example_en: We watched a football match at the local park.
cards.example_zh: 我们在附近的公园看了一场足球比赛。
cards.explain_zh: match强调搭配协调；fit常指尺寸合适。

cards.example_en: We left early to avoid the morning traffic.
cards.example_zh: 我们很早就出发了，以避开早高峰的车流。
cards.explain_zh: 后接名词或动名词：avoid doing，不用to do。

cards.example_en: She saved me a seat near the front.
cards.example_zh: 她在靠前的位置给我留了一个座位。
cards.explain_zh: sit是不及物动词；seat常接人，be seated表就座。

cards.example_en: Throw me the ball before the dog grabs it.
cards.example_zh: 趁狗还没抢到球，快把球扔给我。
cards.explain_zh: 不规则变化：throw–threw–thrown；聚会也可用throw。

cards.example_en: My first task today is to water the plants.
cards.example_zh: 我今天的第一项任务是给植物浇水。
cards.explain_zh: 作动词用task sb with doing sth，表示指派任务。

cards.example_en: It is normal to feel nervous before an interview.
cards.example_zh: 面试前感到紧张是正常的。
cards.explain_zh: normal强调符合常态；ordinary强调普通、不特别。

cards.example_en: My goal is to swim across the pool unaided.
cards.example_zh: 我的目标是不靠帮助游到泳池对面。
cards.explain_zh: 目标用set或achieve；进球用score a goal。

cards.example_en: I always associate the smell of cinnamon with home.
cards.example_zh: 我总是一闻到肉桂的气味就想起家。
cards.explain_zh: 动词尾音/eɪt/；名词、形容词尾音/ət/。

cards.example_en: He wore a blue jacket to the picnic.
cards.example_zh: 他穿了一件蓝色夹克去野餐。
cards.explain_zh: feel blue表示心情低落；颜色较浅用light blue。

cards.example_en: She stayed positive even when rain spoiled our picnic.
cards.example_zh: 即使下雨毁了我们的野餐，她仍然保持乐观。
cards.explain_zh: 检测结果positive指阳性，不一定是好消息。

cards.example_en: Taking the bus is our cheapest option today.
cards.example_zh: 今天乘公交车是我们最便宜的选择。
cards.explain_zh: option指可选方案；have no option but to后接动词原形。

cards.example_en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
cards.example_zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。
cards.explain_zh: 复数为boxes；a box of后接盒中物品。

cards.example_en: The kitten fell asleep inside an empty cardboard box.
cards.example_zh: 小猫在一个空纸箱里睡着了。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: A huge dog was sleeping beside the tiny kitten.
cards.example_zh: 一只大狗正睡在那只小猫旁边。
cards.explain_zh: 本身表示极大，常用absolutely huge加强语气。

word.example_en: The new lighting system reduces energy consumption in public buildings.
word.example_zh: 新照明系统降低了公共建筑的能源消耗。

word.example_en: Investment in renewable energy can reduce dependence on fossil fuels.
word.example_zh: 投资可再生能源能够减少对化石燃料的依赖。
